skill.name: liquidity-depth-analyzer
skill.description: DEX liquidity depth analysis and slippage estimation for swaps, route selection, position sizing, and AMM price impact checks.
skill.summary: Analyze DEX liquidity depth, slippage, and price impact before trade execution.
skill.author: BarisSozen

security_audit.summary: The single static finding is a false positive caused by a Markdown code fence around a static TypeScript configuration example. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or executable behavior was found in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 46 starts a fenced TypeScript example, and lines 47-51 define static configuration values. There is no Ruby, shell command, or executable instruction in this prompt-only skill.

content.value_statement: DEX swaps can fail when liquidity depth, slippage, or price impact is unclear. This skill guides structured checks for pool depth, route quality, and trade sizing.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether available liquidity is at least three times the planned trade size.
Estimates price impact in basis points using spot and expected execution values.
Calculates minimum output after a configured slippage tolerance.
Reviews route choices for low depth, high price impact, and weak profit margin.
Returns clear abort reasons for pools, depth, impact, or profit problems.
limitations: Requires current pool data, spot prices, and trade size from the user or connected tools.
Does not execute trades, submit transactions, or access exchanges by itself.
Does not replace legal, tax, financial, or risk management advice.
Cannot guarantee execution outcomes during volatile blocks or congested networks.

use_cases.title: Pre-Trade Swap Review
use_cases.description: Evaluate pool depth, expected output, price impact, and slippage before approving a DEX swap.

use_cases.title: Route Selection Support
use_cases.description: Compare candidate routes and reject paths with shallow liquidity or excessive execution impact.

use_cases.title: Risk Gate Definition
use_cases.description: Turn liquidity and slippage rules into clear thresholds for automated trade decision workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Swap
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one planned DEX trade.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this planned swap for liquidity depth, price impact, and slippage. Trade size: [amount]. Pool liquidity: [depth]. Spot price: [spot]. Expected output: [output].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Routes
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate route selection across several pools.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these DEX routes for depth, price impact, and minimum output. Recommend the safest route and list any abort reasons for rejected routes.

prompt_templates.title: Size A Position
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced position sizing with liquidity constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the largest trade size that keeps price impact below 50 basis points and depth at least three times trade size. Show the reasoning clearly.

prompt_templates.title: Review Automated Risk Gates
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of bot decision rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these liquidity, slippage, and profit thresholds for an automated DEX strategy. Identify weak gates, missing abort reasons, and safer parameter values.

output_examples.input: A trader asks whether a planned swap should execute against a pool with limited depth.
output: Reason: available depth is below the three times depth target.
Next step: split the order or select a deeper route.

output_examples.input: A bot developer compares two routes with different expected outputs and slippage tolerance.
output: Preferred route: route B, because it has lower price impact and stronger minimum output.
Rejected route: route A, because projected profit is weak after slippage.

output_examples.input: An analyst asks for threshold checks before enabling an automated strategy.
output: Depth gate is clear and measurable.
Price impact gate should remain below 50 basis points for routine trades.
Add a required profit-after-slippage check before execution.

best_practices: Provide fresh pool depth, spot price, expected output, and gas assumptions for each review.
Use conservative thresholds when volatility or block congestion is high.
Record abort reasons so failed opportunities can improve later route logic.
anti_patterns: Do not execute a swap when depth, impact, or minimum output is unknown.
Do not treat historical liquidity as proof of current execution quality.
Do not ignore gas, fees, and slippage when validating trade profitability.

faq.question: Does this skill execute DEX trades?
faq.answer: No. It provides analysis guidance and decision checks only.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide trade size, pool depth, spot price, expected output, fees, gas assumptions, and slippage tolerance.

faq.question: Can it compare Uniswap and Curve routes?
faq.answer: Yes, when you provide route data, liquidity depth, expected output, and pool assumptions for each route.

faq.question: Is this financial advice?
faq.answer: No. It is an analytical workflow for technical review of liquidity and execution risk.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What is the main safety rule?
faq.answer: Do not proceed unless liquidity depth, price impact, and profit after slippage are known.
